records.title: SlotGuard: Stop Oversharing Private Local Context in LLM Agent Transcri
records.reason: SlotGuard focuses on privacy-preserving transcript redaction at an agent boundary; the abstract does not claim inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: WAR: Workload-Aware Rollouts for Synchronous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The system optimizes rollout generation during synchronous agentic RL training; training-only efficiency is outside the target scope.

records.title: Neuromorphic Hardware Materials for Intelligent Artificial Perception and Multimodal Fusion: From Sensing to Cognition
records.reason: A neuromorphic hardware review covers perception and multimodal fusion broadly without an LLM inference/serving contribution.

records.title: RECON: Benchmarking Agent Memory for Compositional Reasoning over Long Contexts
records.reason: RECON is a benchmark for agent memory reasoning, not an inference-time efficiency or serving method.

records.title: TurboVec: A Case Study in Cost-Efficient Private Retrieval for Enterprise RAG via Codebook-Oblivious Quantization
records.reason: TurboVec speeds up and reduces memory for the vector-retrieval layer of enterprise RAG, but the paper evaluates ANN retrieval/indexing rather than LLM inference or serving. Its systems adjacency is clear, while contribution to the in-scope model serving path remains uncertain.
